issues.claim: It also advertises 200+ cases a year, yet the only ways in are a phone line staffed weekdays 9 to 5 and a form that appears to email the partners.
issues.problem: Overstated and partly contradicted by the cited page. The contact page publishes an email channel (larry@wileylavender.com) alongside the phone, and its own copy says 'call, email, or visit us'; the attorney bios also publish each partner's address. So phone + form are the only ways to book a consultation (which the FAQ does support), not the only ways in.
issues.fix: Rewrite as: '...and the only ways to book are a phone line staffed weekdays 9-5 and a web form (the site also lists a partner email address).'

issues.claim: No client portal, document upload or payment link - a client who wants to send a pay stub at 8pm has only a message box.
issues.problem: The absence of a portal, upload and payment link is confirmed, but 'has only a message box' ignores the partner email published on the same contact page and in both bios, which a client could use at 8pm.
issues.fix: Say '...has only a message box or a partner's published email' (or 'no after-hours way to hand over documents').

issues.claim: No drafting or case-management tooling is visible, and there are no job listings, suggesting no paralegal bench.
issues.problem: The absence of listings is stated as fact but was verified on one board only. SimplyHired does return zero results for the firm name, yet the researcher's own notes record that Indeed, LinkedIn Jobs and ZipRecruiter were blocked (403), so 'no listings' anywhere is not supported. The inference about the paralegal bench is correctly hedged ('suggesting').
issues.fix: Say 'and no job listings turned up on the boards we could check (SimplyHired: zero), suggesting no paralegal bench' - or drop the job-listing clause entirely.

issues.claim: Sources note: 'matrimonial and Chapter 7 in the services menu: https://www.wileylavender.com/'
issues.problem: Misattributed citation. The home page lists Matrimonial, Business and Corporate, Real Estate/Zoning and Land Use, and Estate Planning (banner); 'Chapter 7' appears nowhere on the home page and is not one of the seven options in the contact-form service menu - it appears only in Pankaj Maknoor's bio, which is cited separately.
issues.fix: Cite contact-us for the service menu (which includes Matrimonial) and pankaj-maknoor for Chapter 7; remove 'Chapter 7' from the home-page line.

issues.claim: You run a two-partner matrimonial and litigation practice on Amboy Ave.
issues.problem: The address and the two named attorneys are confirmed, and the site calls them 'our partners' / 'an established legal partnership'. But labelling it a 'matrimonial and litigation practice' understates the published mix (business/corporate, real estate/zoning, estate planning, personal injury, liquor licenses), and 'litigation' appears in the FAQ and a bio rather than as a home-page service area.
issues.fix: e.g. 'a two-lawyer matrimonial and commercial-litigation practice (plus real estate, business and estate work)'.

issues.claim: Phone hours are Monday-Friday 9-5 with no after-hours coverage.
issues.problem: The 9-5 hours are stated on the site; 'no after-hours coverage' is an inference from those hours plus the absence of any answering-service mention, not something the firm states. It is presented as fact here.
issues.fix: Say 'phone hours are published as Mon-Fri 9-5, and no after-hours or 24/7 line is mentioned'.

issues.claim: Impact figures: 130-190 hours / $3,900-$5,700; 110-190 hours / $3,300-$5,700; 65-130 hours / $2,000-$3,900; plus 15-40 extra booked consultations.
issues.problem: Arithmetic at the stated $30/hr is correct and every range sits inside the analysis model, but the audit body shows no assumption basis (inquiries per year, minutes per inquiry, share of handling removed), and the 15-40 consultation uplift is a modelled guess presented as a number. The $30 rate is the $30.33 NJ median rounded down - accurate, but should be flagged as a median, not actual staff pay.
issues.fix: Add one short parenthetical, e.g. '(assuming roughly 400-700 inquiries a year and 25-35 minutes of handling each, 40-60% of it removed)', and label the consultation uplift 'modelled'.

issues.claim: Audit body length (target: at most ~450 words).
issues.problem: The body runs ~449 words excluding em dashes and ~456 if dashes count as tokens - at, and arguably just over, the ~450 ceiling. Not a factual error but it needs trimming for the limit.
issues.fix: Cut ~15-20 words: shorten the closing disclaimer to 'Illustrative estimates; confirmed in discovery.' and tighten one 'Why this works' bullet.
